assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The site boundary and the three key-area polygons are provisional rough boundaries derived from the public announcement (SRC-2026-BJ-GH-QUAL-PREANNOUNCEMENT), not the official redline.
assumptions.impact: When the official redline and key-area polygons are released, site_boundary, key_areas, land_use, roads, green_space, public_space, buildings, phasing and every recomputed metric must be regenerated. Provisional areas must not be used for precise-area or approval claims.

assumptions.statement: Floor area ratio, building height, building density, green-ratio control and setback are not present in the public site package (see ranges/planning_limits.json).
assumptions.impact: These indicators are recorded as unknown/to-be-confirmed and do not participate in precise scoring. Building footprints in buildings.geojson are illustrative for structure/density study only and are not parcel-level retain/renovate/demolish conclusions.

assumptions.statement: The Jing-Zhang railway heritage alignment and the Xiaoyue/Qinghe water lines in constraints.geojson are indicative, inferred from public information.
assumptions.impact: They must not be read as official rail alignments, blue lines, heritage control lines or flood-control basis; official surveys are required for implementation.

assumptions.statement: AI scenarios, pilgrimage landmarks, annual events, developer-community and scenario-open operations are conceptual suggestions and reference schemes.
assumptions.impact: They are not confirmed government actions, investment commitments or approved implementations, and require professional teams and the organizer to deepen, including data, privacy, licensing and safety review.
